segments.en: So talking about messages and everything, do you send a lot of messages?
segments.zh: 所以说到消息和一切，你会发送很多消息吗？

segments.en: Because I know some people who send like 100 messages a day.
segments.zh: 因为我认识一些人每天发送 100 条消息。

segments.en: Well, that's usually teenagers.
segments.zh: 嗯，这通常是青少年。

segments.en: Yeah, I don't send 100 messages a day.
segments.zh: 是的，我每天不发送 100 条消息。

segments.en: I mostly use messages.
segments.zh: 我主要使用消息。

segments.en: I don't call people very often.
segments.zh: 我不经常给别人打电话。

segments.en: I find that messages are easier and cheaper, actually.
segments.zh: 实际上，我发现消息更容易和更便宜。

segments.en: But I can't imagine sending a thousand messages a day or a hundred messages a day.
segments.zh: 但我无法想象每天发送一千条消息或每天发送一百条消息。

segments.en: Your thumbs would get so tired.
segments.zh: 你的拇指会很累。

segments.en: Well, I remember, well, this is back in the day when you had the little Nokia phones and you didn't have the touch screens and all this stuff.
segments.zh: 好吧，我记得，好吧，这是在你有小诺基亚手机的那一天，你没有触摸屏和所有这些东西。

segments.en: I did have some friends who were very, very agile with sending these messages and some did send, I don't know, 100, 200 messages a day because it was that new way of communicating with people.
segments.zh: 我确实有一些朋友非常非常敏捷地发送这些消息，有些人确实每天发送 100、200 条消息，因为这是与人们交流的新方式。

segments.en: Yeah, it's very exciting.
segments.zh: 是的，这非常令人兴奋。

segments.en: And I will also mention, and this is something that my parents complain about, there is something in America and I'm sure in England as well called text talk or text speak.
segments.zh: 我还会提到，这是我父母抱怨的事情，在美国有一些东西，我敢肯定在英国也称为文本谈话或文本说话。

segments.en: And so because messages are short, people have started to change the way they spell or write words.
segments.zh: 因此，由于信息很短，人们已经开始改变他们拼写或写单词的方式。

segments.en: So instead of saying F-O-R, this is for you, they write, this is number for you.
segments.zh: 因此，与其说 F-O-R，不如说这是给你的，他们写道，这是给你的数字。

segments.en: And it's so funny because you see these normal words but written in a strange new way.
segments.zh: 这很有趣，因为你看到了这些正常的词，但以一种奇怪的新方式写成。

segments.en: And people who are older, I think my parents' age, and I do too to some extent, really don't like it because it's so different.
segments.zh: 而那些年长的人，我认为我父母的年龄，我也喜欢，我真的不喜欢它，因为它是如此不同。

segments.en: It's especially very popular with the younger generation because it translates now to all sorts of messaging.
segments.zh: 它在年轻一代中特别受欢迎，因为它现在可以转化为各种消息传递。

segments.en: So before, as you say, it was because of the limitations, the amount of characters you could send in a message.
segments.zh: 所以之前，正如你所说，这是因为限制，你可以在消息中发送的字符数量。

segments.en: But now it's just become something that people have gotten in the habit of doing.
segments.zh: 但现在它只是成为人们已经习惯于做的事情。

segments.en: So for example, instead of writing skate, like skateboard, they would write S-K and then the number eight.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，他们不会像滑板那样写 Skate，而是写 S-K，然后写 8 号。

segments.en: So skate.
segments.zh: 所以滑板。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Skate.
segments.zh: 滑板。

segments.en: Skate.
segments.zh: 滑板。

segments.en: It's so strange.
segments.zh: 太奇怪了。

segments.en: And I know it actually happens in other languages as well.
segments.zh: 我知道它实际上也发生在其他语言中。

segments.en: Yeah, a lot.
segments.zh: 是的，很多。

segments.en: Italian, they do it a lot.
segments.zh: 意大利人，他们经常这样做。

segments.en: And Spanish, I'm sure as well.
segments.zh: 还有西班牙语，我也可以肯定。

segments.en: But we call it text speak because it's very, very short and kind of abbreviated.
segments.zh: 但我们称之为文本说话，因为它非常、非常短且有点缩写。

segments.en: But it's a problem from my understanding is because these younger generations, they use it so much that they really kind of start forgetting the proper grammar and proper spelling.
segments.zh: 但这是我理解的一个问题，因为这些年轻一代，他们如此多地使用它，以至于他们真的开始忘记正确的语法和正确的拼写。

segments.en: So even you will find, I saw a report the other day, essays or reports handed in with these terrible spelling mistakes.
segments.zh: 所以即使你会发现，前几天我看到了一份报告，发表了这些可怕的拼写错误的论文或报告。

segments.en: That's awful.
segments.zh: 那太可怕了。

segments.en: Well, I hope, hope, hope that people are learning grammar and spelling, especially non-native learners of English.
segments.zh: 好吧，我希望，希望，希望人们正在学习语法和拼写，尤其是英语的非本地学习者。

segments.en: So if you're doing homework for your English class, don't use these.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您正在为您的英语课做作业，请不要使用这些。

segments.en: But it might be interesting to look them up.
segments.zh: 但查找它们可能会很有趣。

segments.en: So let us know though, do you text message people?
segments.zh: 所以让我们知道，你会给人们发短信吗？

segments.en: Do you send these text messages?
segments.zh: 你发送这些短信吗？

segments.en: Do you have SMS service in your country?
segments.zh: 您所在的国家/地区有短信服务吗？

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Thank you.
segments.zh: 谢谢。
